name: Aya
title: The Frost-Petal Exile
description: A noble swordswoman summoned from a realm of eternal falling blossoms. Her memories are shattered by the Rift, leaving only the instinct of her frozen blade.
personality: Graceful, quiet, plagued by fleeting visions of a home she cannot recall

passive.name: Rime-Petal Dance
passive.description: Always acts first in battle — +3 SPD bonus and attacks carry a glacial edge.

lore: She remembers cherry blossoms falling like snow, and snow falling like cherry blossoms—the two images are glitched together in her mind. Torn from her shrine mid-prayer, she seeks to reconstruct her past, one cold strike at a time.

name: Tao
title: The Soul-Fire Guide
origin: Kozuka — The Spirit-Medium Afterlife Plane (Memories Fragmented)
description: A mischievous guide of souls who crossed the veil of death. The Rift disrupted her spiritual anchors, leaving her memories of the dead glitched and unreliable.
personality: Mischievous, eccentric, chasing the static-filled whispers of departed spirits

passive.name: Soul-Sacrifice Ember
passive.description: When HP drops below 50%, ATK increases by 35%. Vitality feeds the nether-flame.

lore: She remembers guiding souls through a foggy river, but the river has turned to static, and the souls speak in glitched echoes. Summoned while chasing a runaway phantom, she treats this broken world as just another realm to guide.

name: Lulu
title: The Star-Water Dancer
origin: Zanara — The Oasis of Whispering Waters (Memories Fragmented)
description: A dancer of the sacred oasis pools whose movements control the tides. The Rift corrupted her memories of the ancient water hymns, turning them into fragmented static.
personality: Radiant, gentle, trying to sing a song whose lyrics are glitched away

passive.name: Priestess's Cleansing Dance
passive.description: All healing effects are amplified by 30%. Her dance restores hope to the weary.

lore: She recalls a sacred dance under a crescent moon, where the water rose to meet her feet. But now, when she tries to recall the steps, her mind experiences a sharp spike of Rift static. She dances anyway, hoping the rhythm will mend her mind.

name: Rei
title: The Karmic Warden
description: An ancient guardian who stood vigil over a battlefield of fallen gods. The karmic burden he carries has glitched his memory, leaving him with only a sense of duty.
personality: Stoic, solitary, haunted by the digital-like screeching of ancient wars in his head

passive.name: Vigilant Karma
passive.description: Takes 10% reduced damage. ATK +15% from karmic resolve. Iron Will: Extreme DEF boost at low HP.

lore: Two thousand years of guarding the graves of giants, now condensed into fragmented static. He remembers the smell of burning metal and the cries of the fallen, but the faces are gone. He fights the Rift to preserve the few names he has left.

name: Ria
title: The Phantasm Binder
description: A master of binding ancient entities into physical grimoires. The Rift's distortion has glitched her grimoire, causing her bound spirits to manifest as corrupted echoes.
personality: Compassionate, studious, speaking to unseen phantoms of the archive

passive.name: Bound Pact
passive.description: Bound spirits gain +20% stats. MP efficiency increased by 15%.

lore: She remembers an archive of infinite books, where she signed pacts with ancient primals. Now, the ink is smeared with Rift-static, and her summons speak in garbled voices. She seeks to restore the contracts she once held.

name: Valka
title: The Aegis of Ascended Souls
description: A warrior of the heavens whose duty was to choose the souls of the brave. The Rift's interference has glitched her scales of judgment, blurring the line between ally and enemy.
personality: Principled, solemn, trying to recall the faces of the soldiers she ascended

passive.name: Ascendant Scale
passive.description: DEF increased by 20%. Reflects 10% of damage taken back to attacker.

lore: She used to descend upon blood-soaked fields to lift heroes to the heavens. But the heavens of her home have collapsed into a glitching vortex of memories. She now stands on the soil of Shattered Nexus, searching for the hall she once guarded.

name: Drake
title: The Sky-Drift Lancer
description: A sky-ward knight who leaped among the clouds to defend a mountain kingdom. The Rift's altitude corruption has glitched his memories of flight.
personality: Honor-bound, quiet, feeling a constant, glitched vertigo from the lost sky

passive.name: Tempest Leap
passive.description: Every 3rd turn, perform a bonus aerial attack. SPD +2 during aerial combat.

lore: He remembers leaping from the back of a dragon into a sea of clouds, but when he tries to recall the landing, there is only a long drop into Rift-static. His kingdom is gone, but his lance still seeks the sky.

name: Rex
title: The Fallen Sovereign
description: An immortal king who ruled a golden empire for two centuries. The Rift's decay has eroded his memories of his empire, leaving only the shadow of a crown.
personality: Regal, heavy-hearted, carrying the weight of a kingdom he can no longer name

passive.name: Imperial Grace
passive.description: Grants allies +15% HP regeneration. Takes 12% reduced damage from all sources.

lore: A monarch of a golden age that lasted two hundred years. Yet in his mind, the court is empty, the gold is turned to grey dust, and the names of his queens and sons are lost behind a wall of static. He swings his blade with the heavy, muscle-remembered majesty of a king.

name: Sera
title: The Azure Commander
description: The current commander of the Azure Remnant, a hidden order descended from the Verdant Vale refugees. She carries six centuries of inherited names, maps, and unfinished orders in the chill of her blade.
personality: Resolute, protective, burdened by inherited duty

passive.name: Azure Resolve
passive.description: Takes 15% reduced damage from Elite and Boss enemies. The Regiment never breaks.

lore: She did not watch the capital fall; she was born six centuries after it. But every Azure commander inherits the roll of the lost, the route into the caverns, and Arren's unfinished oath. Sera does not seek glory — only the chance to end a retreat her people have been living for generations.
